title: Thai-Style Eggplant Stir Fry in a Chinese Curry Sauce
description: A delicious fusion of Chinese and Thai flavors, this eggplant stir fry is a quick and easy dinner option. The Thai-style curry sauce adds a rich and creamy texture to the dish.
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sugar, and chili flakes. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the eggplant is tender.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat in the microwave or on the stovetop until hot and steaming.
